title: List Wallets Response
description: Successful wallet list response for the authenticated client.

data.description: One entry per wallet owned by the authenticated client.

items.description: A single wallet belonging to the authenticated client.

balances.description: Balances keyed by 3-letter ISO currency code.

additionalProperties.description: Balance figures for a single currency within a wallet. All amounts are decimal strings to preserve precision.

input.description: Cumulative amount credited to the wallet in this currency.

output.description: Cumulative amount debited from the wallet in this currency.

total_balance.description: Only present when `conversion_currency` is set on the request. Shows the wallet's balances summed and converted into the requested currency. Amounts are approximate because FX rates fluctuate.

converted_to.description: Currency the totals were converted into — echoes the request's `conversion_currency`.

approximate_total_balance.description: Sum of all currency balances converted into `converted_to`.

approximate_total_input.description: Sum of all currency inputs converted into `converted_to`.

approximate_total_output.description: Sum of all currency outputs converted into `converted_to`.
